includeStyle.message: Keep the page's colours and fonts
includeStyle.description: Whether the computed style of what was captured is carried into the book. Not a switch on the Style Library, which runs either way.

includeStyleHint.message: Carry the page's own look into the book - colours, fonts, borders, lists and alignment - so that code, tables and pull quotes still look like they did. Off, the book is plain text for the reading system to lay out as it likes. The Style Library runs either way: hiding a banner does not depend on this.

readerModeHint.message: Keep only the article, dropping navigation, sidebars and comments. Applies to Save Page and Add Page as Chapter only. Pages that are not articles are saved whole.

reviewBeforeSavingHint.message: Open Save Page and Save Selection in the chapter editor instead of downloading straight away, so the book can be previewed, edited and described first. The editor's Generate button saves the file.

styleLibrary.description: Opens the style library on the page the popup was opened from. CSS applied to a page while it is captured - not the stylesheet of the book that comes out, which lives in the chapter editor. The styles this page would take are listed under the button.

styleLibraryHint.message: Write and switch on the CSS applied to pages while they are captured, so that what is saved is the page without its banners and sidebars. Not the stylesheet of the book that comes out - that one is in the chapter editor.

captureFirst.description: Checkbox under the Style Library button. Ticked, the library opens on a fresh copy of this page to preview styles against.

captureFirstHint.message: Take a copy of this page for the library to preview, so a style can be written against what will actually be saved - and so an element can be picked out of it by clicking. This is a capture, so it takes as long as saving the page does. Clear it to open the library straight away, on the last page captured.

restrictedTabMessage.message: Save as eBook cannot read this tab. Browser pages, the extension store and PDF files are off limits - try it on an ordinary web page.

busyMessage.message: Work in progress! Please wait until the current eBook is generated.

noTabMessage.message: Save as eBook could not find the page to read - please try again.

notStartedMessage.message: Save as eBook could not start this command - the extension did not answer. Please try again.

stoppedMessage.message: The capture stopped before it finished - leaving or reloading the page while it is being saved ends it. Nothing was downloaded, please try again.

previewNote.message: This shows how the chapter renders. Pagination, fonts and margins are the reading system's and differ between devices.

previewEmpty.message: This chapter has no content to preview.

viewModeHint.message: Reading view. Switch mode to edit this chapter.

removeModeHint.message: Click an element to remove it. Select parent widens what a click takes.

textModeHint.message: Click in the text to edit it. The chapter title is edited in the chapter list.

bookCssHint.message: CSS for the whole saved book. Not the same as the Style Library, which changes pages while they are captured.

chapterCssHint.message: CSS for this chapter only, applied after the styles captured from its page.

bookMetadataHint.message: What the eBook says about itself. A field left empty is taken from the chapters.

chapterMetadataHint.message: What this chapter says about itself. A field left empty is taken from the page it was saved from.

metadataLanguageHint.message: A language tag, like en or pt-BR

metadataLanguageIgnored.message: Not a language tag - this will be ignored.

metadataDateIgnored.message: Not a date - this will be ignored.

metadataDateGenerated.message: the day the eBook is generated

discardEditsConfirm.message: This chapter has unsaved edits. Close without saving?

discardChangesConfirm.message: This book has unsaved changes. Close without saving?

removeChapterConfirm.message: Do you want to remove this chapter?

removeChaptersConfirm.message: Do you want to remove all chapters?

storageWriteFailed.message: Your changes could not be saved: the browser refused to write to this extension's storage, which usually means it is full. Nothing was stored - free some space, or discard the buffered chapters, and try again.

blankChapterTitleWarning.message: Every chapter needs a title. The chapter without one is selected.

confirmDeleteStyle.message: Are you sure you want to delete this style?

styleRegexUnsafe.message: This pattern can take an unusable amount of time to match, which would freeze the extension while a page is being saved. Rewrite it without a repeat inside a repeat - or use a glob pattern, which cannot have this problem.
styleRegexUnsafe.description: Shown when a regular expression has a shape that can backtrack exponentially. See regexPatternRisk in styleLibrary.js.

styleRegexTooLong.message: This pattern is too long - $max$ characters at most.

styleFilterMatches.description: Filter for the styles that apply to the page the popup was opened on

styleFilterTheme.description: Filter for styles applied to every captured page, rather than to pages matching a pattern

styleLibraryEmpty.message: The library is empty. Make a style to start.

styleNoSelection.message: Pick a style on the left to see what it does, or make a new one.

styleScopeTheme.description: The choice that makes a style apply to every captured page

stylePatternMissing.message: No pattern yet - this matches nothing.

styleTestInvalid.message: Not a usable regular expression - this matches nothing.

styleTestNoUrl.message: Paste a URL above to check the pattern against it.

styleOriginForked.description: Badge for a bundled style the user has edited - it can still be reset

styleEnabledHint.message: Apply this style while a page is being captured

styleCssHint.message: Applied to the page while it is captured, not to the eBook
styleCssHint.description: Said beside the CSS box, to distinguish it from the eBook stylesheet in the chapter editor

styleResetConfirm.message: Replace your version with the built-in style?

styleNeedsPattern.message: A style for matching pages needs a pattern. Add one, or set it to apply to every page.

styleDiscardEditsConfirm.message: This style has unsaved changes. Discard them?

stylePreviewClearConfirm.message: Discard the captured page this preview is showing?

stylePreviewNothingApplies.message: No style applies to this page yet.

stylePreviewHowTo.message: No page captured. Open the extension on a page you want to style and choose "Style Library ..." with "Capture this page first" ticked, to preview your styles against it.

stylePreviewNote.message: The captured page with the styles above applied, rendered as the eBook will show it. A rule that hides an element here keeps it out of the eBook; fonts and margins are the reading system's.

stylePickHint.message: Point at something in the preview to hide it.

stylePickNeedsStyle.message: Pick a style on the left first - the element you click is written into it.

styleExportHint.message: Write this style to a file, to keep it or to give it to somebody else

styleExportNothing.message: There is no style to export.

styleImportHint.message: Open a style file, or paste one below. Imported styles are added as your own - they never take the place of a built-in.
styleImportHint.description: Said above the file button and the paste box in the import panel

styleImportPastePlaceholder.message: or paste a style file here

styleImportKeepBoth.description: Import the styles that clash as new styles beside the ones already in the library, rather than over them

styleImportNothingPasted.message: Nothing to import yet - open a file, or paste one in the box.

styleImportNotAStyleFile.message: This is not a style file.

styleImportNoStyles.message: There is no style in this file.

styleImportUnreadableFile.message: That file could not be read.

styleImportCollisions.description: Styles the file holds a copy of - the heading over the choice between replacing yours and keeping both

styleImportStrippedWhy.message: These fetch a file from another site every time a page is captured, which tells that site what you are reading. Nothing a site style does needs one.
styleImportStrippedWhy.description: Why remote url() and @import are taken out of imported CSS

styleImportUnusablePatterns.message: Patterns that will not be used

styleImportUnusablePatternsWhy.message: These would take an unusable amount of time to match, so they are never run and the styles below apply to nothing. Rewrite the pattern - a glob pattern cannot have this problem - or delete the style.
styleImportUnusablePatternsWhy.description: Why an imported regular expression is refused

noStyleForThisSite.message: No style for this site - make one
noStyleForThisSite.description: Shown in the popup under the Style Library button when nothing in the library covers the page

saveDestination.description: Popup menu entry to open the save destination settings page.

saveDestinationDownload.description: Radio button label for the direct download save protocol.

saveDestinationCrosspoint.description: Radio button label for the CrossPoint save protocol.

saveDestinationCrosspointUrl.description: Text entry label for the CrossPoint server URL.

saveDestinationCrosspointPath.description: Text entry label for the CrossPoint destination path.

saveDestinationApply.description: Button text for the button to apply the save destination settings.
